locationMethod: Inventory longitude/latitude transformed EPSG:4326 to EPSG:32612 and located in this run exact native cell bounds; no other case native face IDs reused
coverageRule: Route membership is recorded provenance, not modeled coverage. Only an exact native cell containment in this run geometry counts as located, and locating a point does not validate road depth.

boundaryAmbiguity.meaning: Point falls exactly on a shared native cell boundary; lowest source native face ID selected

timeCoverage.note: Frames, interval and endpoints are read from the native output. The normal forecast product is 57 quarter-hour frames from 2026-11-01T17Z through 2026-11-02T07Z, but that count is not assumed here.

restartLimitation: Type1 restores water/momentum but not cumulative cna precipitation/infiltration state; not an identical continuation
